_doc: Voice settings shared by every video (tools/make_vo.py). A line's role in videos/<name>/audio/lines.tsv picks a voice from 'roles'; a video can override any of this in its own audio/voices.json. Voices are VieNeu-TTS v3 Turbo presets: `.venv/bin/python tools/make_vo.py --audition="some line"` renders the line in every voice for comparison (out/voices/index.html).
_tempo: speaking rate per role, without changing the pitch: 1 = as the model speaks, .92 = 8% slower. A line can set its own in lines.tsv.
_pauses: seconds of silence after each sentence inside a line: after '.', '!' or '?' (sentence), and after '…' or '...' (ellipsis, a trailing-off pause). Commas are left to the voice.
